title: First-time rollout checklist — progressive disclosure & onboarding flow (signoff)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce first-time setup friction for creating a rollout by presenting a progressive disclosure checklist that guides engineers through minimal, high-impact choices (model, target environment, traffic percentage, and safety toggles). The flow should: 1) surface only 3–4 required inputs initially, 2) provide an optional expanded view for advanced settings, 3) show inline, actionable validation and estimated cost/latency impacts, and 4) include clear audit/action links for Private and Dedicated customers.

Design artifacts: interactive prototype in Figma (see attachments). We focused design decisions on clarity for fast engineers vs discoverability for platform teams. This ticket captures the design review cycle, stakeholder feedback, and signoff tasks.

Key decisions so far:
- Default collapsed view shows: rollout name, model selector (with recommended model and performance hint), environment selector, and traffic slider. Advanced options are hidden under an "Advanced settings" accordion.
- Inline cost/latency estimate placed under model selector; values are approximations with a tooltip explaining the calculation (batching assumptions + KV cache reuse). UX copy avoids absolute numbers (prefers ranges) to set expectations.
- Validation: required fields validate on blur with succinct errors; prevent submit only when model+env incompatible (engineering constraint). Error language aligned with engineer-first tone.
- Accessibility: all controls are keyboard-navigable, labels persist when collapsed, contrast meets AA for critical call-to-action, and the traffic slider has an accessible numeric input fallback.

Trade-offs discussed:
- Showing full cost breakdown in the flow increases cognitive load; product requested an opt-in link to a detailed cost modal instead. We implemented a lightweight estimate to keep the primary path fast.
- Automatic suggestions for model/quantization were proposed by Research but deferred to a follow-up (see sub_issues) to avoid scope creep for the initial rollout.

Prototype link and artifacts:
- Figma prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/console-rollout-checklist-33107
- Motion spec: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-rollout-motion-spec
- PRD summary (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Console/First-time+Rollout+Checklist

Acceptance criteria for signoff:
- Final screens match Figma prototype and microcopy approved by PM
- Dev has clear tokens/specs for spacing, colors, and motion durations
- a11y checklist passed in manual review and core telemetry events defined for analytics
- QA checklist created and assigned to QA lead

Next steps once approved:
- Handoff to ENG (ENG-4012) with implementation notes and API compat matrix
- Create evaluation job to compare time-to-first-rollout vs baseline post-launch
- Track a small A/B test to validate that progressive disclosure increases successful rollouts without increasing support tickets
